cats.name: West
cats.bio: *I am in a Foster Home. West is a white kitten with a black tail. Even though she is the littlest kitten in this family, done be fooled, she is the biggest cuddler. Are you a fan of cuddles? Apply today! Littermates: North, South, East

cats.name: South
cats.bio: *I am in a Foster Home. South is a white kitten with tabby patches. She is energetic and talkative. Do you want a cute ball of energy in your home? Apply today! Littermates: North, East, West

cats.name: East
cats.bio: *I am in a Foster Home. East is a white kitten with black spots. She is busy and playful. Do you think you can keep up with her at playtime? Apply today! Littermates: North, South, West

cats.name: Veronika
cats.bio: Veronika is a tiny bundle of energy with a big personality! This playful kitten is always on the move, chasing toys, and turning everything into an exciting adventure. She's a nonstop purr machine whenever she sees people, but don't expect her to sit still for long, there's simply too much playing to do! Veronika absolutely loves other cats and would likely thrive in a home with a playful feline companion who can keep up with her enthusiasm.

cats.name: Dahlia
cats.bio: Dahlia may be tiny, but her voice is anything but! This adorable little girl has a lot to say, and she wants to make sure everyone hears it! Dahlia is a very vocal kitten who isn't shy about expressing herself. Whether she's looking for company or simply feels like sharing her thoughts with the world, this little chatterbox can turn an ordinary day into a full blown conversation! She especially loves having people around and isn't a big fan of being left alone. With her larger than life voice and endearing personality, Dahlia is sure to keep her future family entertained.

cats.name: Little Mamma
cats.bio: * I am in a foster home This petite princess is as beautiful as she is sweet. She loves spending her days playing and wrestling with her siblings, and you'll often find her right in the middle of the fun when she's feeling comfortable and secure. While she has a loving heart, she is very shy and will need a patient and understanding family. She can be nervous around people and will often run away if approached too quickly. Building trust with her takes time, but it's well worth the effort. Once she feels safe, her affectionate side begins to shine. She enjoys gentle pets and loves to snuggle up at nap time, especially in a cozy spot where she feels protected. Watching her slowly gain confidence and choose to come closer is incredibly rewarding. This special girl is looking for a calm home with adopters who understand that trust can't be rushed. With patience, kindness, and lots of love, she will continue to blossom into a wonderful companion.  If you have a gentle heart and the patience to let her come to you on her own terms, this lovely little kitten may be the perfect addition to your family. Littermates: Furgus, Stripy, Willard

cats.name: Shorty
cats.bio: Meet Shorty! Shorty is an adorable 3-month-old girl with a gentle heart who's slowly discovering that humans can be pretty wonderful! This sweet little kitten is still shy, but thanks to the patience and kindness of her foster family, she's beginning to enjoy gentle pets, has discovered the joys of purring, and has even allowed herself to be picked up! Shorty is looking for a calm, patient family who will give her the time and space she needs to continue building her confidence. With a little love, understanding, and plenty of encouragement, this sweet girl has all the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion! I may be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I may be able to live with children. Please email your completed adoption application to adoption@cochranehumane.ca.

cats.name: Cara
cats.bio: *I am in a Foster Home. Meet Cara, one of three tiny triplet sisters! This friendly, curious little girl loves people and starts purring almost as soon as you pick her up. She is petite, playful, and always ready for a game — and just as ready for her next meal. If you want a kitten who will greet you with purrs and keep you entertained, Cara is your girl. Littermates: Cocoa and Choco

cats.name: Toffee
cats.bio: Meet Toffee! Meet Toffee, an adorable 3-month-old kitten with a sweet little face that's sure to melt your heart! At this age, the world is full of exciting things to discover, and Toffee has plenty of growing, playing, and exploring ahead of her. She's looking for a loving family who can provide lots of patience, playtime, and affection as she grows into her personality. If you're looking to add a little sweetness to your life, Toffee might be your perfect match! ❤️ I might be able to live with other cats and/or dogs. I might be able to live with children. Email the filled-out adoption form to: adoption@cochranehumane.ca

cats.name: Pepper
cats.bio:
Peppy little Pepper is the softest and fuzziest of felines. Despite still being easily startled, she loves being held and petted by her foster mom and falling asleep on her lap. Known for her purr, she also loves playing with toys, chasing her sisters through the cat tunnel and exploring her environment. Highly food motivated and fully litter box trained, Pepper will perk up any adoring adoptive home. Purr-haps yours?

Pepper was born approximately August 2026.

cats.name: Apple Crumble
cats.bio: Apple Crumble may have a sweet name, but this little girl is still learning that the world isn't such a scary place! Found as a stray, Apple Crumble is understandably feeling overwhelmed by her new surroundings. Right now, she prefers the safety of her hiding spot and may hiss or growl when she's frightened. It's simply her way of asking for a little space while she figures things out. At just three months old, Apple Crumble has so much growing and learning ahead of her! She'll need a patient, understanding family who can offer her a quiet environment, safe hiding places, and gentle, positive experiences without rushing her.
